2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3557|a43ce262.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|a43ce262.text: Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6741|174473b0.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|174473b0.text: Recently, a night elf druid named Naralex discovered a network of underground caverns within the heart of the Barrens. Believing he could use the caverns' springs to restore lushness to the Barrens, the druid began siphoning the energies of the fabled Emerald Dream. His vision somehow became a nightmare, however, and soon the Wailing Caverns changed into a den of vicious, deadly predators. It is said that Naralex still resides somewhere inside the labyrinth, trapped beyond the edges of the Emerald Dream.

6741|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6741|864c5566.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|864c5566.text: The Wailing Caverns has its entrance at the Lushwater Oasis southwest of Crossroads in the Barrens.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

1014-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-accept.text:
Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.

I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, $N. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.

Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
1014-accept.title: Arugal Must Die

1098-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
1098-accept.text:
In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence.  It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!

So here is your task, $N.  Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent.  Find them, and if they require aid then give it.

This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, $N.  Do not fail.
1098-accept.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

356-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-accept.text:
The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
356-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

358-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-accept.text:
The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  

The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!

Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
358-accept.title: Graverobbers

421-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-complete.text: You have served me well, $c.  It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
421-complete.title: Prove Your Worth

422-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-accept.text:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
422-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

422-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-progress.text: Before I know what we are dealing with here, $c, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal.  Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
422-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-accept.name: Rane Yorick
425-accept.text:
My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon Silverpine Forest and report to High Executor Hadrec.  But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

We escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn.  He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.

Kill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal.  Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.
425-accept.title: Ivar the Foul

425-complete.name: Rane Yorick
425-complete.text:
Ah, thank you.  You have my gratitude, $N.

And I will include you in the report I make to my superiors.
425-complete.title: Ivar the Foul

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

427-accept.name: Executor Zygand
427-accept.text:
The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade.  We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.

But the Deathguard has larger concerns.  The Lich King's army grows in number each night.  We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.

Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.
427-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

437-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-complete.text:
I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, $N, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

The Scourge have lost ground this day.  Your value to the Forsaken grows.
437-complete.title: The Dead Fields

437-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-progress.text: Have you defeated Nightlash, $N?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
437-progress.title: The Dead Fields

438-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
438-accept.text:
$N, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
438-accept.title: The Decrepit Ferry

438-complete.name: Unknown
438-complete.text:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses.  And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
438-complete.title: The Decrepit Ferry

439-accept.name: Unknown
439-accept.text:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
439-accept.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-complete.text:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal.  The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!
439-complete.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-progress.text: $N.  You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
439-progress.title: Rot Hide Clues

440-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
440-accept.text:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
440-accept.title: The Engraved Ring

440-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-complete.text:
A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago.  She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed.  I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.
440-complete.title: The Engraved Ring

440-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-progress.text: Hello, $N.  What brings you back to Brill?
440-progress.title: The Engraved Ring

441-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
441-accept.text:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
441-accept.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

441-complete.name: Raleigh Andrean
441-complete.text:
Yes, this ring was my wife's.  Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times.  I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

Such feelings have long since grown cold within me.  But desire does still burn in my dead heart, $N.

Desire for revenge.
441-complete.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

443-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
443-accept.text:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
443-accept.title: Rot Hide Ichor

447-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-complete.text: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, $N.  These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause.  I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.
447-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

447-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
447-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

450-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
450-accept.text:
You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, $N.

When Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard.  Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us.  But his findings might prove to be of worth.  He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.

Retrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
450-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

477-complete.name: Unknown
477-complete.text:
<Prying open the lid of the crate, you find an assortment of carefully-packed objects. On the top of the crate lies a bundle of maps, yellowing with age, that appear to depict Silverpine Forest and other parts of western Lordaeron.

Underneath the maps is a mysterious-looking magical pendant.>
477-complete.title: Border Crossings

478-accept.name: Unknown
478-accept.text: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
478-accept.title: Maps and Runes

478-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
478-complete.text:
Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.

It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.

Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.
478-complete.title: Maps and Runes

479-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
479-accept.text:
Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...

The conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.

Take the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.
479-accept.title: Ambermill Investigations

481-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
481-accept.text: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
481-accept.title: Dalar's Analysis

481-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
481-complete.text:
Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.

That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.

I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.
481-complete.title: Dalar's Analysis

482-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
482-accept.text:
Of course! How could I have forgotten?

Ambermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.

We cannot allow this to happen...

It will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.

Relay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
482-accept.title: Dalaran's Intentions

482-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
482-complete.text:
Ill news you bring, $N. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.

I must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
482-complete.title: Dalaran's Intentions

516-progress.name: Shadow Priest Allister
516-progress.text: Have you located their base yet, $N? Time is of the essence!
516-progress.title: Beren's Peril

530-accept.name: Raleigh Andrean
530-accept.text:
Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer.  Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge.  If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.

I last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.
530-accept.title: A Husband's Revenge

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)
